name: agent-team-setup
title_zh: 先面试你一轮，再给项目铺好整套多智能体协作层
tagline_zh: 受够了每次开新项目都手写 AGENTS.md、HANDOFF.md 和一堆 zone README？
tagline_en: Tired of hand-writing AGENTS.md, HANDOFF.md and per-zone READMEs for every new repo? An organizer agent.
desc_en: Use this skill to set up a multi-agent work structure in ANY project: an organizer agent interviews the owner (which roles/zones, which stack per zone — always offering options), then generates the full protocol layer: AGENTS.md, HANDOFF.md, per-zone READMEs, inter-agent mailboxes, project security-review skill, dev-port table and quality gates. Trigger when the user says "set up the agent workflo
why_zh: 关键在「先访谈再落盘」：角色和分区由你拍板，不是模板硬套，所以生成的协议层能对上你真实的协作方式。
why_en: The interview-first design means roles and zones come from your decisions, not a rigid template, so the generated protocol layer.
limit_zh: 它只产出协议文档和目录骨架，不写业务代码、不配 CI、不装依赖；分区和技术栈得你当场答得出来，含糊其辞它会一直追问。
limit_en: Only emits protocol docs and directory skeletons — no business code, CI or deps. You must answer the zone/stack questions; it keeps asking and.
title_en: Interviews you first, then scaffolds a full multi-agent.
